call_purpose: You called because some of your students said the lesson videos keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones, and you hoped it gets sorted out.

covered.text: We opened the lesson link you shared on desktop Chrome, on Safari and on a phone, and the video played on each, so we could not reproduce the problem from our side. This is not yet resolved.

customer_next_steps.text: Ask one affected student to record a short screen recording of the video loading and send it to us along with the lesson link.

support_next_steps.text: We will raise this with our team and get back to you. We cannot give a timeline yet.
